component.name: Reader
component.summary: Read PDFs, EPUBs, and comic books

description.p: Read PDF and EPUB documents and CBZ comic books. Open files from your file manager, search your documents, and keep a local reading library.
Decode only visible comic pages when opening documents and generating thumbnails.
Reader is available on enzim Apps. Open a PDF, EPUB, or CBZ, search inside documents, and return to where you left off.
The sidebar transitions more smoothly when you show or hide it.
Add Flatpak packaging for enzim Apps.
